scope: Independent fixed SELECT queries in one read-only transaction; inspected only selected identities, enrollment, event names/counts, stored numeric measurements, contact labels/resolution states and aggregate outcome counts. No transcript, prompt body, configuration or artifact content read. No model or external calls, enrollment, event insertion or source writes.
limitations: This verifies saved report consistency with the supplied snapshot and selected identity set. It does not prove complete session discovery or complete host capture.
Null cost and human-correction values remain unknown. Historical positive controls demonstrate stored observations, not recording of the currently selected tasks.
Snapshot byte preservation is checked during this review; earlier source acquisition history remains separate controller evidence.
